title: Mid-ayah pause/resume
description: Pending real-imam clip: silence or gap mid-ayah then the same ayah continues. Distinct from stall-after-lock trailing pad.
notes: If the recording already contains the pause, leave insertSilence.atAudioSeconds null.
Internal unvoiced frames are skipped like live mic; do not confuse with stall-after-lock fed pad.
Must not jump to a wrong surah across the pause.
